simulated_user.persona: a product manager who wants high-level topic areas for a dashboard. The product manager does NOT have strong knowledge of clustering algorithms and how they work.
simulated_user.goal: Group the questions by programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).

outputs.agent:
To begin establishing your grouping strategy, how should we handle the mix of web development, database/ORM, language-specific, and desktop/tool-related topics seen in this dataset?

A) Organize by primary language or framework ecosystem (e.g., separate groups for JavaScript/AJAX, PHP/Magento/Drupal, Java/Hibernate/NHibernate, Scala/Haskell, and Excel/Qt tools)
B) Organize by software development layer or task type (e.g., Frontend/Web APIs, Backend/Database & ORM, Core Language Features, Desktop/Office Integration, Version Control & DevOps)
C) Merge them into broader, high-level categories (e.g., Web & API Development, Data Persistence & Management, Programming Languages & Paradigms, Desktop & Productivity Tools, Dev/Source Control)
D) Keep every distinct technical domain strictly separate, creating highly granular clusters for each specific technology or use case (e.g., a dedicated cluster just for AJAX, another just for Magento, another just for LINQ, etc.)
E) Other — please describe your preference.

How should we handle questions that naturally span multiple technical domains in this dataset (e.g., "Using LINQ to query a text file" mixes C#/.NET with general querying, or "Calling an Excel Add-In method from C# application" mixes desktop tools with code)?

A) Assign each question to its primary programming environment (e.g., C#/.NET bucket) for consistency
B) Create dedicated cross-domain integration clusters that capture hybrid/tool-linking questions separately
C) Prioritize the underlying task or problem type over the specific tool (e.g., group by "Data Querying/Processing" regardless of language)
D) Tag questions with multiple labels but keep the final cluster assignment to a single, most relevant category
E) Other — please describe your preference.

When dealing with questions that focus on specific frameworks or libraries versus those focused on core language concepts, how should they be grouped relative to each other?

A) Merge framework-specific questions together with core language questions under a single, unified category for that language (e.g., all Magento/Drupal issues grouped with general Java/Hibernate topics)
B) Keep framework/library clusters entirely separate from core language clusters (e.g., distinct groups for Magento, Hibernate, Scala, and Haskell regardless of language overlap)
C) Prioritize framework/library grouping, even if it means splitting core language concepts across multiple clusters
D) Group only by the primary problem domain, letting framework mentions serve as metadata rather than drivers for cluster separation
E) Other — please describe your preference.
